name: "DIY Nets"
description: Thanks to this instructional reference book, you'll be able to cast nets out into the water. Soon, you'll have a good supply of fresh fish.

name: "Silage" Mincer
description: Allows creating a universal feed that will satisfy any pet.

name: 14k Lantern
description: Allows finding triad notes while searching buildings. They will lead to their secret place.

name: Abakan
description: A universal weapon for hunting and fighting.

name: Acid gland
description: You can get sulfuric acid from this gland.

name: Acidoemitter
description: Creates zones on the battlefield that deal acid damage. Has a wide effect radius.

name: Acupuncture Kit
description: Methods of ancient healing practice will help in battle and survival.

name: AIDA 1
description: A special suit created for protection from sporeblooms. It also provides a slight advantage in battles against biomutants.

name: AIDA 2
description: An Improved version of the AIDA. It protects the wearer from the effect of sporeblooms and helps when fighting biomutants.

name: AIDA 3
description: A new prototype developed by Progress. This is used for working in the most dangerous zones of the overgrown cities.

name: AKM-C
description: Effective against single enemies. Loses accuracy with each shot, but increases your accuracy if used to kill an enemy.

name: Alien Blaster
description: With this mysterious weapon, all attacks will be simply cosmic.

name: All-In
description: Luck favors the bold: fire away! Each subsequent attack with this weapon consumes less AP.

name: Alphacelone
description: Cures all diseases, injuries, and negative effects.

name: Aluminum Scrap
description: Scrap can be collected from auto spare parts and household appliances. It is melted down in a smelter into an aluminium ingot.

name: Amanita
description: Red fly agaric that is hard to spot in this swamp

name: Antibiotics
description: Needed to treat several illnesses

name: Antiquarian's Feedbag
description: With this backpack of an experienced junk dealer, you will find twice as many items for resale when searching buildings.

name: Antirad
description: Salvation from radiation.

name: Arctic Armor
description: Legendary winter gear. With this on, you'd be fine even in the North Pole in the paws of a polar bear.

name: Arctic ATV
description: Can travel across any sort of terrain at the same speed. No repairs needed

name: Armor Plate
description: Manufactured in the Irkutsk workshop.

name: Armored Uniform
description: Metal and leather armor plates have given this gear a new life. In armor like this you can assault everything from a bandit base to a mutant den.

name: Army Bulletproof Vest
description: Professional military equipment found in military warehouses.

name: Assault Rifle Ammo
description: 5.45x39mm cartridges. You can use it with the AK-74, AKS74U, or RPK-74.

name: Atom
description: Cross the wasteland using atomic energy! The transport does not break down and does not require fuel.

name: Atomic Pack
description: This pack was forgoten at the casino by certain Citizen Zero.The more radiation it accumulates,the greater the capacity.Accumulated radiation can be transfered to the pack.

name: Ave Maria
description: Your prayers have been heard. Increased accuracy. When killing an enemy with this weapon, damage from all weapons increases.

name: Bad Santa
description: Shake loose gifts like a bad cop beats out a confession. Even the bushes will crack after a few shots.

name: Bamboo flute
description: Elder Jiang Yue collects Chinese valuables appropriated by triad bandits. He will exchange this item for coins. Such items can be found in ruined cities.

name: Bamboo Steamer
description: Allows you to cook fish and create a stock of food that doesn't go bad.

name: Banker's Table
description: Allows you to craft Kevlar Vests and Joker grenades.

name: Barrel
description: It is used in alcohol production.

name: Battery
description: It keeps portable devices working

name: Bayan
description: Can be sold to a buyer in a settlement for a profit.

name: Beetle Juice
description: The most refreshing drink you can find in any bar in the Underworld. Skeletons receive a mop along with their drink.

name: BelAZ
description: Once a haul truck, now it is a nuclear-drawn off-roader no longer requiring any fuel. Has high carrying capacity.

name: Bellows
description: It help you to work with a forge chimney.

name: Biathlon-84
description: A damage bonus for each defeated target-now that's good sportsmanship!

name: Bicycle
description: A bicycle significantly increases your speed of your movement across the area

name: Bicycle with a cart
description: A bicycle significantly increases your speed of movement cross the area. The cart allows you to carry heavy things.

name: Big Fifty
description: A seriously deadly weapon! It can take out any opponent, ignoring all armor..

name: Bingo
description: The battlefield is your game table. "Cross off" rows of enemies and let bleeding take care of the rest.

name: Bio-energy Drink
description: A powerful boost of energy. Limited edition.

name: Bioblocade Inhaler
description: The E.M.B.A. project was not completed, but this medical development managed to enter limited production.

name: Biocontainer
description: Increases the storage time of items and increases the effectiveness of herb collection. An invention of the Progress biologists for working in the field.

name: Biodetector
description: Searching buildings reveals trails of biological activity. Biomutants can be tracked down from the information gathered.

name: Biofuel
description: This concentrate is used for the production of fuel for any type of transport.

name: Biomass
description: Extracted from mycelium. The scientists are studying the biomass and create prototypes of useful devices using it as a base.

name: Biomaterials
description: Biomaterials of the E.M.B.A. project should be handed over to Maria, the Progress geneticist. They are found in ruined cities, when searching through overgrown buildings and in surviving houses.

name: Biomutant Brain
description: Biomaterials of the E.M.B.A project should be handed over to Maria, the Progress geneticist. They are found in ruined cities, when searching through overgrown buildings and in surviving houses.

name: Biomutant Egg
description: Biomaterials of the E.M.B.A project should be handed over to Maria, the Progress geneticist. They are found in ruined cities, when searching through overgrown buildings and in surviving houses.

name: Biomutant Embryo
description: Biomaterials of the E.M.B.A project should be handed over to Maria, the Progress geneticist. They are found in ruined cities, when searching through overgrown buildings and in surviving houses.

name: Biomutant Larva
description: Biomaterials of the E.M.B.A project should be handed over to Maria, the Progress geneticist. They are found in ruined cities, when searching through overgrown buildings and in surviving houses.

name: Biopollen
description: Biomaterials of the E.M.B.A project should be handed over to Maria, the Progress geneticist. They are found in ruined cities, when searching through overgrown buildings and in surviving houses.

name: Bioreactor
description: Unlocks an additional campfire slot.

name: Biosynthesizer
description: One of the most practical prototypes created by Progress. It allows for biomass to be turned into useful resources.

name: Biotonic
description: Biomass diluted with water under special conditions is a great way to stay hydrated. The taste is unusual, but it protects against radiation!

name: Black chip
description: Chip from the Jackpot casino. Used in the event shop. Obtained by turning in mardkes cards in the event window. Marked cards can be found in cities - in Gambling Houses and on Dance Floors.

name: Black coal
description: Excellent source of fire. Also used in the smelting of iron and steel Can be found in boiler rooms, power stations, and other energy facilities. Sometimes found in warehouses.

name: Black Deck Crate
description: Fighting cheaters and thugs is a noble cause. Even better when it pays off.

name: Black Vultures
description: I need to track down and kill dangerous mutants. The Forester told me to bring back trophies as proof of my hunting skills.

name: Black-and-Red
description: Though it doesn't wear out, it has a chance of breaking down with each use. Has a small chance to find Black Deck lottery tickets. Once enough tickets are found, you get the coordinates of a prize stash!

name: Blackjack
description: Calculation and luck: this rifle can inflict terrible wounds that won't leave the opponent alive for long.

name: Blank
description: D4 construction and installation cartridge.

name: Blood mold
description: Can be found in radioactive swamps.

name: Boiled condensed milk
description: A whole can of boiled condensed milk will let you return to your childhood

name: Boiled corn
description: The taste of boiled corn will let you return to your childhood

name: Bomb
description: Deal with bunker and vault doors.

name: Bone glue
description: Use this glue and rags to stick some pieces together.

name: Bone Vest
description: Protects against stray bullets, but works best against monster claws and spells.

name: Borschevik Flamethrower
description: A powerful flamethrower using self-regenerating chemical fuel.

name: Bowl of rice
description: This rice is cooked just right!

name: Broadleaf plantain
description: Broadleaf plantain. surprisingly green for a plant in the wasteland

name: Broken motorcycle
description: This is a broken Ural motorcycle with a sidecar. Maybe I can repair it.

name: BS-4 Power Armor
description: Ambitious plans to create a perfect battle suit existed only paper. Progress compiled all the developments and finally created this masterpiece.

name: Bulletproof vest
description: Professional military equipment found in army warehouses.

name: Bunny Costume
description: A clearly handmade, but cute nonetheless, Easter Bunny costume. You won't find another of these in the wastelands.

name: Bunny Treat
description: Easter Bunnies' favorite treat.

name: Business Claus's Card
description: Wherever you are, open the door to a world of great deals. A special offer for every season! We delivery.

name: Butcher's Backpack
description: All the knives and hooks in the bottom of this bag may be disturbing... But the speed and efficiency they grant while working with carcasses is worth it!

name: Butcher's Van
description: The same van from all the scary stories, on its way to your house. What tales will they tell about it now that you're behind the wheel?

name: Butterfly Knife
description: The favourite knife of street hustler.If used to kill an enemy,applies the Sprint effect.

name: Bye-Bye Rad
description: An anti-radiation serum from California.

name: C-3 Cologne
description: A classic Soviet scent that discourages even the hungriest radioactive mutant form attacking. Prevents random enemy attacks.

name: Cabin in the Wilds
description: A long sleep grants Outcast's Repose. It reduces bleeding damage and increases movement range in battle.

name: Candy Cane
description: A sweet treat for holiday spirit.

name: Canned Beans
description: Yep,just beans,You might want zo leave the tent flap open at night.

name: Canned Water
description: For emergencies. Submariners were supplied with this kind of canned water. You never know how much is left inside.

name: Caps
description: You can exchange caps for new items in the shop.

name: Car battery
description: A car battery that is suitable for use.

name: Cart
description: A cart helps you to carry more items

name: Catalysis-E
description: Recommended to shoot at a target surrounded by opponents. Once hit, the target and everyone around it become vulnerable to incoming damage.

name: Caustic Distillate
description: The fiery drink will make you rush faster than the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse combined!

name: Cement
description: A standard bag of cement, 25 kg. It seems that it is still usable.

name: Ceramic bulletproof vest
description: Developed by the S.O.V.A. scientists. It is rare to come across one far way from their cities.

name: Chainsaw
description: Legendary soviet Druzhba chainsaw. You can use it to get wood fast.

name: Charcoal pile (burned)
description: You can dig out the charcoal

name: Charcoal pile (burning)
description: This charcoal pile is still burning, you shouldn't touch it

name: Chemist Crossbow
description: Reduces the damage dealt by the target. Recommended to shoot multiple times at high-damage enemies.

name: Chemistry lab
description: It's stationary chemistry set. It doesn't wear out.

name: Chemistry set
description: Flasks, test tubes, and other items which are used for synthesizing chemicals.

name: Chest of Transmutation
description: Contains a random skin card. Must be opened in camp.

name: Chimney
description: A flamethrower for punishing anyone on the naughty list this year.

name: Chinese bulletproof vest
description: Developed by Chinese military - hence, provides especially good protection in fights against criminal triad gangs.

name: Chinese coin
description: Used for conducting business with guests from China. Elder Jiang Yue gives them for certain items and for fighting against the triad.

name: Chinese energy drink
description: Invigorating tincture made from ginseng root.

name: Chinese fireworks
description: It can be launched into the air, but it's better aimed at opponents.

name: Chinese Valuables
description: Elder Jiang Yue collects Chinese valuables appropriated by triad bandits. He will exchange this item for coins. Such items can be found in ruined cities.

name: Chitin armor
description: Old Lore: Mutants have adapted to the environment and dangers of the radioactive wasteland better than anyone else. Their light and durable chitin provides an extraordinary amount of protection.

name: Cho-ko-nu
description: Antique Chinese crossbow serves well in the world of apocalypse.

name: Chocolate
description: Nutritious and decicious! A rare delicacy in the wasteland.

name: Chocolate Bar
description: Tasty and filling.Just don't overdo it-dentists are hard to find these days.

name: Chocolate Bunny
description: A fun and festive treat, provides strength when you're in a scrape.

name: Christmas gift
description: Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

name: Cipher of the Triad's Lock
description: In destroyed cities, the triad hides caches and secures them with combination locks. Here's the code for one of them. You can find these combinations in the triad's training camps in the cities.

name: Coal
description: Good fuel, also useful for filters and creating items in the chemistry lab.

name: Collector
description: One sighted shot from this, and no grifter will be able to hide. Applies an effect that increases the hit chance from a Collector.

name: Combined armor
description: Hazmat suit reinforced with thick leather and metal plates. still provides substantial protection against radiation, but is now much more useful in battle

name: ComCon-3 Paste
description: A compact nutrient concentrate, it was developed at E.M.B.A. for the space program and other extreme conditions.

name: Commando
description: Inflicts lingering wounds and shreds tendons like cobwebs!

name: Condensed milk
description: A whole can of condensed milk will immediately reduce your hunger

name: Constructor's Case
description: Contains a random skin card. Must be opened in camp.

name: Copper Scrap
description: Scrap can be collected from coins and cables. It is melted down in a smelter into a copper ingot.

name: Corn
description: Must be boiled for 6 hours

name: CPE Leader
description: With a damage bonus for every ally (up to 15%), your squad will be invincible! Plus, excellent radiation resistance and increased carrying capacity provide a survival advantage.

name: Cranberry
description: Little berries almost hidden in the thick brush

name: Crane
description: Effective against unarmored targets at long range. Ignores target's counterattack.

name: Crouching Tiger
description: Exclusive moification of the Type 64 pistol, developed for the special units of the Chinese army.

name: Cursed Coin
description: Magical creatures come and go, but commerce is forever. Use this coin to summon an otherworldly merchant for a mutually beneficial exchange

name: Cybermitten
description: A robot uprising has never been so festive. Build your own army of cybersnowmen!

name: Cypress SMG
description: Quickly mows down enemies with short bursts.

name: D-Composite
description: A liquid polymer, used in Progress laboratory developments. Scientists created it to interact effectively with new mutated vegetation.

name: Daredevil (Fly)
description: A motorcycle possessed by the spirit of the Headless Horseman's cursed horse.

name: Data Disk
description: The Progress scientists are ready to trade all of their developments for any data about biological anomalies.

name: Deck Lottery Ticket
description: Can be found using the Black-and-Red flashlight when searching buildings. If you collect enough tickets, you can assemble the coordinates of a Black Deck prize stash.

name: Delta G Radio
description: Only works on one unknown frequency. Turning it on attracts madmen.

name: Demon mask
description: The demon imprisoned in this mask will guide you in battle, but it feeds on your life energy.

name: Demon's Wings
description: Power summoned from the deepest pits of hell, allowing one to soar above this wasteland of sin.

name: Diesel
description: Fuel for high-powered engines

name: Disassembled motorcycle
description: Can be used to assemble a complete motorcycle or cut up for scrap

name: Dragon Scale
description: Effective in combat against large groups of enemies. Each kill increases damage dealt.

name: Dragon's Roar
description: It will crush the crowd of fools who replied on thier Armor.

name: EA Spectrum
description: First-class Expeditionary Armor: high radiation resistance, choice of additional weapon in combat, increased defense and experience in battles with biomutants.

name: Easter Cake
description: A crucial part of any Easter feast.

name: Easter Egg
description: An egg decorated with paint.

name: Electric car
description: The battery in this electric car will last for 10-20 years. Welcome to the future!

name: Electric Motor
description: It will help with a construction of mini hydro power plant in Tyumen.

name: Electrodes
description: Electrodes for welders.

name: Energy drink
description: A jolt of energy for several days!

name: Erebus-273
description: On a hit, can reduce target's attack range and movement. Recommended to use against shooters then leave the effect zone.

name: Eternal Rod
description: Who said that ghosts only remain behind the living? This otherworldly rod will work forever, and the speed of fishing is multiplied!

name: Eurekognasol Stimulant
description: Reduces fatigue,boosts attention and concentration. Dosen't treat acne.

name: Expedition Case
description: These are the containers that Progress uses to transport useful cargo.

name: Expeditionary Ration
description: Developed by the E.M.B.A. supply department. A balanced ration with experimental supplements.

name: Expeditionary Transporter
description: Long sleep grants Metabolic Rest. It increases maximum health, food, water, and energy.

name: Extractor
description: Used for the effective extraction of biomass from pieces of mycelium.

name: FATUM E-93
description: Tread through the abyss of postapocalyptic hell! Your ticket back is a powerful ability: knock back enemies and restore your health in battle.

name: Fear
description: Gives power to enchanted weapons and some demon perks. Can be obtained by scaring residents in settlements. Minions also bring the fear.

name: Fido
description: UAZ-469 off-road car, commonly known as the 'Uazik.' Needs gasoline.

name: Field Uniform
description: A military uniform supplemented by a steel helmet and bulletproof vest, it is equally suited for both the battlefield and the post-nuclear world, where danger lurks around every corner.

name: Firewood
description: Basic fuel for the campfire. There are more efficient sources of fire, but firewood is the most familiar. Can be chopped from logs.

name: Firework
description: Santa Claus's level increases the stats of magical artifacts

name: First Aid Kit
description: Using a first aid kit fully removes negative effects and heals all diseases and injuries.

name: Fist of the Sky
description: Effective against armored targets at long range. Can stun the target.

name: Flesh
description: A violent psychopath has been turned into a living weapon as punishment. On command, he spits out his own teeth at his opponents; they do, however, grow back quickly.

name: Forged knife
description: Nikita gave me this knife when we got back from Kiev slaughterhouse. Like his father Kiril said, 'When your rifle misfires, when your grenade doesn't go off, when your friend runs - all you'll have left is your knife'.

name: Formalin Gas Pistol
description: Just a few shots take away the ability to walk and attack. Turn a dangerous opponent into an incoherent sack of biomass!

name: Forward's Stick
description: Take your shot and skate away: killing an opponent grants one free movement.

name: Frosthorn
description: This sword was pulled out of an ice block in the Arctic. Deadly cold still emanates from its blade.

name: Furniture
description: I can turn it into firewood

name: Fury
description: The famous truck that Gerda drove all across Europe. Now it's your turn to conquer the ruined world!

name: Galley Module
description: Allows you to make Biotonic in the kitchen.

name: Gangster
description: Time to take risk:lethal force makes up for low accuracy.

name: Gas Mask Filter
description: You must periodically change a gas mask´s filter for it to keep functioning properly.

name: Gasoline
description: Fuel for cars and motorcycles

name: Gehenna
description: Incinerate a host of opponents with hellfire! Then another one... And another!

name: Genefruit
description: Only encountered in the wildest parts of overgrown cities. Herbicide will help with getting to them through the wall of roots and stalks.

name: Generator
description: Serves as a portable power source

name: Gerin Flycatcher
description: After landing in battle, they grow into huge individuals that devour enemies. They are grown on Gerin Flycatcher.

name: Ghost suit
description: It seems like when i´m wearing this stupid costume, monsters think i am one of them

name: Giant Solifuges
description: I need to track down and kill dangerous mutants. The Forester told me to bring back trophies as proof of my hunting skills.

name: Gigawattor
description: This weapon was born in the workshop of a truly brilliant mad scientist. Or insanely brilliant. What difference does that make when you can finally shoot lightning?!

name: Gingerbread
description: Eat it and awaken the powers of Santa Claus within yourself.

name: Glutton's Bag
description: You'll never have to deny yourself anything at holiday parties again: everything that doesn't fit in your stomach will wait for you in this bag.

name: Gold Coin
description: Used to open chests with unique items. Can be obtained by turning in evidences from ruined cities in the event window, and also in the event shop.

name: Gold Token
description: Used in the event store. Can be obtained by trading in madmen's necklaces in the event window. You can find the necklaces in fire stations and printworks in cities, as well as in radio trap locations on the map.

name: Golden Dragon
description: Elder Jiang Yue collects Chinese valuables appropriated by triad bandits. He will exchange this item for coins. Such items can be found in ruined cities.

name: Golden Easter Egg
description: An egg decorated with gold paint.

name: Golden Triad Bag
description: Contains a variety of useful items and treasures from the Middle Kingdom.

name: GP-2000 Gas Mask
description: Protection from radiation in cities.

name: Grenade Launcher Round
description: RPG-7 ammunition.

name: GrowFast
description: A powerful universal fertilizer that accelerates crop growth. Made in the Krasnoyarsk workshop.

name: Guandao
description: "Reclining Moon Blade" will crush anyone who dares to come within the range of its shaft.

name: Halloween Evidences
description: Investigate forgotten serial murders - collect evidences in cities and receive gold coins as reward! Pay special attention to haunted houses and burning craters.

name: Hand mill
description: It helps you to grind grains into flour.

name: Hand-held Railgun
description: A new victory for Progress technologies. The Ampere force is placed on the rails of power of scientists and their allies.

name: Handmade rocket
description: Rocket for handmade rocket launcher

name: Heavy Machine Gun
description: Turns enemies into mincemeat.

name: Helicopter
description: It has no need for roads.

name: Herbicide
description: Destroys mutated plants in the most impassable areas of overgrown cities.

name: Hermetically Sealed Case
description: These sets were used to supply the EMBA project staff members.

name: Hidden Dragon
description: Returns fire once per turn. Even stronger when combined with the Crouching Tiger pistol.

name: High-performance Capacitor
description: Manufactured in the Novosibirsk workshop.

name: Highway Armor
description: Assembled from scrap materials, this set was primarily designed for surviving in the wasteland. It is able to protect its wearer from gunfire of bandits and the teeth of mutants

name: Hijacked Casino
description: A long sleep grants the Dealer's Rest effect, which applies protection from Explosions and increases shotgun damage and accuracy.

name: Hippo
description: An amphibious truck that can cope with anything.

name: Hitman
description: The rifle of a cold-blooded killer: an injured target isn't likely to survive a second shot.

name: Ho Ho Ho
description: Handheld tactical nuclear catapult. Came here from a world where Christmas hasn't been celebrated for a long time.

name: Holiday Energy Drink
description: A powerful boost of energy ⚡+600. Limited edition.

name: Homemade Bulletproof Vest
description: Can be assembled by anyone from the junk at hand.

name: Hunter's Garb
description: Special outfit worn by monster hunters.

name: Hunter's Rifle
description: Shoots silver bullets, so any self-respecting hunter of evil must have one.

name: Hunting Bow
description: Automatic defeat of second opponent (with reduced damage) in one shot. It also deals extra damage to animals.

name: Ice Cream
description: Everyone loves this treat, even an opponent on the battlefield.

name: Iceberg
description: Grants immunity to burning and bleeding effects. An enemy who attacked in close combat has a high chance of getting stunned.

name: Icicle Thrower
description: Santa Claus's level increases the stats of magical artifacts

name: Infernal Coal
description: A substitute for black coal, which is used to make it in the Kiln, the furnace for the themed event.

name: Infernal Prophet
description: 'I love the smell of sulfur in the morning!' Increases fire damage to the target and reduces the target's accuracy. When the target is killed, grants Battle Fervor.

name: Injector
description: A stimulant with a long-lasting effect. Provides an significant energy and a fantastic boost to metabolism.

name: Insulating Tape
description: A roll of blue electrical tape.

name: Invisibility Cloak
description: Its magic will hide the wearer from prying eyes in battle, but be warned-the fabric is extremely fickle.

name: Ionica Gas Mask
description: A gas mask with electrochemical defenses and advanced lens optics. It is powered by disposable batteries

name: IR-190
description: Anti-radiation drug

name: Iron Armor
description: An old solution to a modern problem. This forged metal armor protects the entire body and can help you resist well-armed bandits and large animals

name: Jack O' Launcher
description: Clears out space for a red-hot party... but the enemies aren't likely to be in a celebratory mood.

name: Jackhammer
description: Excellent for street combat: grab it, blast the kingpin, take out his partners. Easy. Less effective against armor.

name: Jackpot Rifle
description: Fires through, piercing all targets in the shooter's line of sight.

name: Jackpot's Crate
description: A token of gratitude from Jackpot for your help. Where she got the funds-better not to ask.

name: Jackpot's Flare Gun
description: A thank you from Jackpot: fire a flare, and she'll send her mechanic to help out. On the battlefield, he appears with a handmade turret.

name: Jade beads
description: Elder Jiang Yue collects Chinese valuables appropriated by triad bandits. He will exchange this item for coins. Such items can be found in ruined cities.

name: Joker
description: It's gone! Emits a strange gas: anyone who inhales it becomes more vulnerable but more effective in battle.

name: Joy
description: Powers a Christmas weapons and some of Santa Claus's abilities. You can obtain it by giving gifts to residents in settlements. Helpers also bring joy.

name: Kettlebell
description: Train with this athletic equipment, and you'll get just as strong as the famous Soviet bodybuilder Vadim Blinov!

name: Kevlar Vest
description: Elegant protection from frag projectiles and explosions.

name: Kholodets
description: A traditional yet rather exotic New Year dish.

name: King of Jokers
description: The people demanded rum, and Jackpot did her best. Unfortunately, the quality isn't very consistent.

name: Knock-Off Energy Drink
description: You can create a makeshift version of almost anything, especially if you're willing to take risks.

name: Kvass
description: A natural bread beverage, it clears the mind and leaves a sensation of summer freshness.

name: Laptyozhnik
description: A very powerful truck that will carry absolutely everything.

name: Lazy Elf
description: The delivery elf will deliver something interesting in every location. Works for Food.

name: Leather Armor
description: this set is the most well.suited for surviving in the wasteland. Its welded metal armor will protect you in battle, while the hat and cloak will shield you from bad weather and radioactive dust

name: Lidiacide-34
description: Psychotropic drug that reduces fatigue.

name: Liquidator Special Forces Armor
description: Sniper-level accuracy, protection from burning substances, and serious armor: the recipe for a moving fortress that nothing can hide from.

name: LMG "Qilin"
description: A powerful burst will knock down not only the target but also the closest enemy.

name: Log
description: Logs are used to make firewod, sticks, and planks. They can be chopped in the forest.

name: Lotus of Death
description: Its bombs envelop enemies in deadly smoke.

name: Machine oil
description: Used to assemble and repair machines.

name: Magic Carpet
description: Can take its owner anywhere, and give any room a splash of style! Hand-wash only.

name: Magic Sweater
description: More durable than it seems. And even better at protecting against scoundrels.

name: Man-Eating Tigers
description: I need to track down and kill dangerous mutants. The Forester told me to bring back trophies as proof of my hunting skills.

name: Marked Cards
description: Turn in marked cards to Jackpot and get black chips! Marked cards can be found in ruined cities - in Gambling Houses and Dance Floors controlled by The Black Deck.

name: MARS
description: The Mobile Automatic Resource Extraction System. It was designed to work on other planets and asteroids, and has now been adapted for simpler tasks. It requires recharging after each resource search cycle.

name: Master's Garb
description: The power of Asian art of war will crush opponents.

name: Mayhem
description: What could make fireworks even better? Shooting them out of a machine gun!

name: Medical Backpack
description: Contains a section with everything needed for survival, like an immediate health boost and the capability to create stimulants.

name: Merry Lantern
description: Under the joyous shine of this lantern, you'll be blessed with Christmas surprises.

name: Metal Detector
description: Detects metal items and parts underground, but it's a slow process.

name: Mi-8 parts
description: Spare parts for Mi-8 helicopter.

name: Midas
description: Every last lynx will be staring down the barrel of a luxurious death!

name: Military uniform
description: Durable and low-maintenance, this uniform was worn by all Soviet soldiers not all that long ago. It is now prized by residents of the wasteland for its defensive and commanding look

name: Mining permit
description: Allows entrance into the titanium ore mine.

name: Modern bulletproof vest
description: This design was completed after the Catastrophe. There aren't many who can afford one.

name: Mosinka
description: The 1891 variant of the trilinear Mosin-Nagant rifle is rightfully considered one of the most renowned small arms to come out of Russia. Requires 7.62x54 cartridges.

name: Moss
description: Found in swamps and forests.

name: Motorcycle
description: Need gasoline for fuel

name: Motorcycle spare parts
description: Use it to repair the Ural motorcycle

name: Mulled Wine
description: Warms you up on cold winter nights.

name: Murmur
description: Supresses the opponent's positions with each shot. Killing an enemy removes all tactical restrictions.

name: Mutated Catfish
description: The Forester asked me to catch several mutated fish. He believes their meat and roe are extremely poisonous. Their population must be wiped out before the contamination spreads.

name: Mutated Pike
description: The Forester asked me to catch several mutated pike. He noticed they are spawning tainted roe, which could be dangerous.

name: Mutated Sturgeons
description: The Forester asked me to catch several mutated fish. He believes their meat and roe are extremely poisonous. Their population must be wiped out before the contamination spreads.

name: Mysterious Fruit
description: Used like a grenade in battle, but instead of dealing damage, it strengthens everybody nearby. Can be cultivated in greenhouse.

name: Nail
description: 200 mm steel nail

name: Nailed box
description: Who knows what's inside

name: Nettle
description: A small ravine overgrown with nettles.

name: Nuclear battery
description: Nuclear battery with an operating life of 20 years. The main active ingredient is tritium. Radiation caused by the dissolution of tritium is considered safe. Can be used to construct an electric car

name: Old Canned Meat
description: The contents, whatever they are, are still edible. They built things to last back in the day!

name: Old Faithful Gas Mask
description: The ultimate radiation resistance. The only catch? The tank drains after a while.

name: Otherworldly Crate
description: Gratitude for settling affairs between this world and the other side.

name: Painkiller
description: Reduces negative effects caused by injuries.

name: Paper fan
description: Elder Jiang Yue collects Chinese valuables appropriated by triad bandits. He will exchange this item for coins. Such items can be found in ruined cities.

name: Paper Lantern
description: Destroyed buildings look eerie in its red glow, but ruins unveil their secrets more readily.

name: Party Popper
description: Santa Claus's level increases the stats of magical artifacts

name: PAS Weaver
description: Completely blocks movement for affected targets. Recommended for use against enemies attacking at close range.

name: Peking Duck
description: A nutritious and extremely delicious dish of Chinese cuisine.

name: Pepperbox
description: One shot, three bodies.

name: Pet Feed
description: Nutritious feed, suitable for any pet.

name: Physicist Crossbow
description: It's hard to shoot red hot rebars even with an optical sight. However, scientists treat this weapon with great warmth.

name: Piece of Mycelium
description: Fungal growths that can be found on the bodies of the biomutants. The source of the biomass. The most effective way to extract it from the mycelium is by using an extractor.

name: Pill of Immortality
description: The miraculous pill of Daoist sages will help you survive in the most difficult situations.

name: Pistol Ammo
description: 7.62x25mm TT cartridges. You can use them with the TT pistol, PPS and PPSh

name: PK 7.62 Kraken
description: This powerful minigun was created under the supervision of Colonel Kurganov as part of the EMBA project.

name: Plank
description: Required for the creation of many items. Manufactured from logs.

name: Player Outfit
description: Risk is your middle name! The less armor and health you have, the greater your dodge chance. Also adds the chance to deal an additional return shot.

name: Poisoned Flask
description: The very brew that makes zombies so bright and cheerful. The rest of us, however, have to suffer side effects to enjoy such a surge of energy.

name: Polar Axe
description: Santa Claus's level increases the stats of magical artifacts

name: Porcelain vase
description: Elder Jiang Yue collects Chinese valuables appropriated by triad bandits. He will exchange this item for coins. Such items can be found in ruined cities.

name: Primitive Bulletproof Vest
description: Better than nothing. The production of such vests has been established in the settlements.

name: Primus stove
description: Camping oil stove. It can replace the fire, if you have some gasoline.

name: Progress ATV
description: The calling card of the research organization. The furthest parts of the continent are accessible to a researcher on an ATV like this one.

name: Progress Bulletproof Vest
description: Part of the mandatory equipment for progress staff members. Issued for work in biological threat zones.

name: Protection Potion
description: Makes the skin of witches and demons thick enough to withstand the Inquisition's fires and peasant's pitchforks!

name: Pumpkin
description: Great for soup.

name: Pumpkin Chump
description: Willing to cover you in battle or carry out a small task. Just don't invite him for lunch-he'll get the wrong idea.

name: Punch-in-the-Box
description: Even your enemies deserve gifts. The kind that will knock them back with a hard uppercut!

name: Puppeteer's Wagon
description: A long sleep grants Carny's Rest. It increases search speed in cities, as well as resistance to radiation and poison.

name: Pyrolytic Grenade
description: Deals significant fire damage for several turns after the explosion.

name: Pyrotechnics Manual
description: A set of instructions for creating fireworks, party poppers, and sparklers.

name: Quads Glowstick
description: A souvenir from the casino, where everyone loves bright and glowing things. Usually distributed as a set of four, but the whole collection wasn't found while searching ruins.

name: Quality Hide
description: Required for the creation of quality leather.

name: Quality Leather
description: Component for crafting and repairing items. Made from quality hides.

name: Rabid Bison
description: I need to track down and kill dangerous mutants. The Forester told me to bring back trophies as proof of my hunting skills.

name: Racer Set
description: Tough out any race against the apocalypse

name: Radioactive mushroom
description: A tiny mushroom emitting a soft green light

name: Rainbow Easter Egg
description: An egg decorated with pink, blue, and green paint.

name: Rambo
description: The weapon of choice for savage avengers, it inflicts more bleeding with each shot.

name: Red chip
description: Chip from the Jackpot casino. Required to complete event quests. After finishing the storyline, it can be spent on Jackpot Wheel spins in the event window.

name: Red Lightning
description: A sporty U-2, miraculously preserved in perfect condition.

name: Refrigerator Backpack
description: Meat and other food last 10 times longer!

name: Replica Substrate
description: Can be obtained by completing Bunker floors. Required to level up replicas. Outside of the Bunker event, Replica Substrate can also be used in combat as a grenade. Replica Substrate drops every 5 floors of the Bunker.

name: Revenge
description: A good player allways has an ace up their sleeve.Fires a return shot.

name: Revolver ammo
description: 7.62 x 38 mm cartridges, you can use them with Nagant revolver.

name: Reykjavik Chainsaw
description: Scandinavian reliability + European efficiency = speedy firewood retrieval!

name: Rice Cultivation Guide
description: Create paddy fields along the banks of water bodies.

name: Rice wine
description: Chinese folk method of combating radiation.

name: Rifle Ammo
description: 7.62 x 54 mm cartridges. You can use them with a Mosin-Nagant rifle and a Dragunov sniper rifle.

name: Rocket-Propelled Grenade Launcher
description: A grenade launcher. Used to destroy armored targets.

name: Rope
description: Let's climb the mountain.

name: RPG Vesuvius
description: A blinding explosion with a huge blast radius: enemies may suffer burning or blindness from the fire.

name: RPO-M Eye of the Storm
description: All will be calm at the center of the explosion, in the eye of a raging storm of death, while all around will be dealt twentyfold damage!

name: Rudolph
description: The healing properties of reindeer antlers will save your life more than once in tough battles.

name: Rusted hacksaw
description: Old hacksaw. Still got most of its teeth

name: Safe from the Casino
description: Got lucky and swiped a safe with something valuable inside! But cracking it won't be easy.

name: Salted meat
description: It has a long shelf life

name: Sanguinary Masha
description: An exquisite cocktail restores vitality in battle. But it's better not to ask about some of its ingredients...

name: Santa's Flask
description: This flask never runs out of water, thanks to snow magic. However, precipitation is radioactive nowadays, so drink cautiously.

name: Santa's Sack
description: This sack can fit gifts for children all over the world. Plus, it'll keep a Christmas ham fresh until next year's fest.

name: Santa's Staff
description: It's hard to make Santa Claus angry. But those who manage to will remember this staff for the rest of their lives.

name: Santa's Tambourine
description: Sometimes you need special weather to fulfill all the wishes people have made. Good news: nature is willing to oblige!

name: Sausage Factory
description: Allows you to create sausage from rotten meat and rotten vegetables in the kitchen.

name: Scarf of 18 Provinces
description: Patience and Eastern perseverance will be rewarded - one just needs to travel enough distance on the map.

name: Schoolbag
description: It allows you to carry more items while you are wearing it.

name: Scientific Monograph
description: Requires thorough study in the camp, but much reading can yield a lot of valuable experience.

name: Scrap metal
description: Found in ruins and craters.

name: Screw
description: Obtained by disassembling broken weapons or vehicle parts.

name: Searcher's Flashlight
description: You'll find absolutely everything with it!

name: Shawarma
description: A refreshing and healthy meal that completely satisfies your hunger and thirst.

name: Shotgun Round
description: 12/70 shells, used in standard shotguns and the sawed-off variety.

name: Silver Coin
description: Spent to progress through the event plot and to increase demon strength. Can be obtained in the event store or by completing quest on the map.

name: Silver Token
description: Used for event quests and to buy goods from the Syndicate Trader. Can be obtained by completing quests on the map.

name: Sipuha
description: Long range and armor penetration.

name: Six Pack
description: Blows up all enemies, no matter the obstacles, with impressive speed.

name: Smuggled Energy Drink
description: To keep your mind sharp and your strength up!

name: Smuggler's Armor
description: Beware the cornered smuggler: the more enemies around, the more desperately they fight back.

name: Smuggler's Flask
description: This flask can hold a lot. No, seriously. A whole lot.

name: Smuggler's Lantern
description: Has a decent chance to find smugglers' ciphers. Collect enough ciphers to determine the coordinates of hidden stashes.

name: Soap
description: A laundry soap

name: Spark plug
description: Required to assemble gasoline engines.

name: Special Ops Tactical Vest
description: This is no bikini - it's a uniquely designed tactical vest that increases your combat effectiveness.

name: Spooky chest
description: Several magical or valuable items inside!

name: Spooky Energy Drink
description: A powerful boost of energy ⚡+666. Limited edition.

name: Sporebloom
description: Produces spores which are dangerous to humans without special protection. On the other hand, they attract the biomutants.

name: Spring
description: Obtained by disassembling broken weapons.

name: SR Delirium
description: Can force the target to fight on your side. Recommended to disable the most dangerous enemies.

name: Stake Thrower
description: A stake to the heart? No, a whole log to the chest! Recommended by vampire hunters.

name: Stale Pryanik
description: Once, such Pryaniks were called differently.

name: Stalk Glowstick
description: A chemical light source, it uses biomass with fluorescent pigments.

name: Starter Set
description: You'll be able to use this set of items to make a quick start in every new game.

name: Stearin
description: Two weapons in one: can switch between assault rifle and rifle modes.

name: Steel armor
description: The pinnacle of armor in the post-nuclear world. Forged from steel, it protects its wearer from all possible threats

name: Stick
description: Required for the creation of simple items. Can be found in the forest, chosen not with an axe, but collected manually.

name: Stimulant
description: A blood transfusion will help to restore health at a hard time. Created using the medical backpack.

name: Storm Snowball Launcher
description: A snowy salvo will crush the most fearsome opponents. Plus, the ones who get snow under their shirt can expect an especially humiliating defeat.

name: Strange TV
description: What?! A Working TV?

name: Strawberry
description: A strawberry bush hidden in the dry grass.

name: Strong bat
description: It's dangerous to go alone! Take this.

name: Strychnine Gas Revolver
description: The gas cartridge revolver, its projectiles with added toxin affect the CNS.

name: Superfilter
description: Clean Water always and everywhere.

name: Support Box
description: Can be opened immediately or combined with a similar box. When combined, the contents become more valuable.

name: T-800 Bulletproof Vest
description: A stylish American bulletproof vest. It's like you're made of metal!

name: Tactical Armor
description: Progress equips its combat division with this armor. It is even highly regarded by the mysterious Vector special forces unit.

name: Taiga Machete
description: Good for both work and combat.

name: Tanning mixture
description: Used to prepare skins.

name: Tatar
description: A big truck for big loads.

name: Tent (taken down)
description: With the tent, it takes less time to get enough sleep. You will also recover better. Needs to be pitched before using

name: Termite
description: Extremely effective against targets with high armor.

name: Terrarium
description: An inexhaustible stream of poisonous spiders pours from this weapon. Enemies will only scream in terror as hundreds of bodies cover them.

name: Tester Armor
description: Gear for working in special conditions: increased radiation resistance, additional defense and experience when fighting biomutants.

name: The Artful Dodger
description: Unlocks an additional slot for safecracking and reading.

name: The Belgian
description: An excellent choice for brief assaults. The high recoil reduces accuracy during long bursts of fire.

name: The Flying Dutchman
description: Forests and rivers are no obstacle for the legendary ghost ship. Navigate any course over the radioactive wastelands.

name: The Saw
description: Battle fervor can be intoxicating... With each shot, you forget your old wounds, and you barely notice new ones.

name: Thermodiffusive Grenade Launcher
description: During the explosion, thermodiffusive processes are initiated, especially effective when in contact with biological entities.

name: Thermonuclear Camping Stove
description: Never worry about bonfires again!

name: Thick Hide
description: Required for the creation of thick leather.

name: Thick Leather
description: Component for crafting and repairing items. Made from thick hides.

name: Threads
description: Sewing is not for men. But for the moment, you have no choice.

name: Titanium Alloy
description: Smelted in the Chelyabinsk workshop.

name: Titanium ore
description: Mined near Magnitogorsk.

name: Top-Tier Card Sharp
description: Allows you to restore 2-6 AP on the next turn once per battle. Additionally, grants +10% damage to any Jackpot weapon!

name: Torch
description: A simple source of light will help you to search at night.

name: Tourist backpack
description: It allows you to carry significantly more items while you are wearing it

name: Toxic lamp
description: The juice of yellow mushrooms mixed with radioactive water produces enough light for searching at night.

name: Toxigen
description: Poisonous gasses break down opponents' immune systems. Victims of a Toxigen blast will take increased damage from poisons.

name: Trace of the Triad
description: A note that will lead to the triad's secret gathering place.

name: Transport repair kit
description: It will reduce the wear and tear of the chosen vehicle. The repair kit can't repair a totally broken vehicle.

name: Trash Pile
description: Appparently, these are the remains of a collapsed wall - there are many bricks visible in the huge pile.

name: Travelling Stove
description: A magical means of transportation for real fairytale heroes.

name: Treats
description: All sorts of lollipops and other candy.

name: Triad bag
description: Trophies obtained in confrontation with the triad.

name: Triad Chest
description: Contains a variety of useful items and treasures from the Middle Kingdom. Must be opened in camp.

name: Trophy Cognac
description: Evidence that scientists also know how to relax.

name: Tube Rifle
description: A laser rifle powered by tube amplifiers. It's just magical! Additional damage to the enemy near the target.

name: Ulcer AMR
description: Large-caliber sniper rifle, enhanced with unique Progress technologies.

name: V-22 Condor
description: A western convertiplane, hijacked by smugglers while adrift on an aircraft carrier.

name: Vector-A
description: The "Vector" special forces unit is armed with such assault rifles. Perhaps this is why their Scouts and navigators are so effective in combat.

name: Vehicle repair kit
description: It will reduce the wear and tear of chosen vehicle. The repair kit can´t repair a totally broken vehicle.

name: Vial of "...amine"
description: The name on this label is illegible, but the bartender from the settlement swore that just one vial got him back on his feet after a bite from a radioactive badger.

name: Vintage Convertible
description: Hop in and speed to your most stylish Christmas ever.

name: Vintage lighter
description: This lighter reminds me of the time I saved Gena, the guy from Tula. I saved his life and stopped him from becoming killer.

name: Vintorez
description: In the arsenal of Soviet special forces demonstrated wonders of accuracy and range.

name: Vulture
description: Excellent for finishing off wounded targets.

name: Wanderer Motorcycle
description: Made to conquer the wastelands.

name: Water purifier
description: It helps you to collect clean water.

name: Weapon repair kit
description: It will reduce the wear and tear of the chosen weapon. The repair kit can't repair a totally broken weapon.

name: Wicker Man
description: Allows you to use the corpse of madmen as fuel for the campfire.

name: Witch's punch
description: Magical brew for the strongest.

name: Witch's Quill
description: Creates random sorcery scroll if given the resources and will.

name: Wolf Talisman
description: Sorcery grants the form and strength of a werewolf.

name: Wolfsbane-1
description: A powerful acid splash burns and poisons a small group of opponents.

name: Workbench
description: It's a stationary tool kit. It doesn't wear out. It's essential for construction.

name: Yamal
description: The tough hunters of the Wild North always keep this pistol on hand. Just in case.

name: Zapor
description: A fuel-efficient Soviet car.

name: ZAZ-968 (Disassembled)
description: You can use it to assemble a vehicle or cut it for scrap

name: Zi-9
description: An agile fighter's best friend! Move and dodge as you shoot opponents.
